title: docs(qa): park the 24 partial-coverage gaps of the 17.7 pre-release runs — 2 recipes, 9 pins, 6 re-pointed clauses, 7 recorded knownGaps
body:
Fixes #22017
Clause-②: no

## What this does

The four 17.7 pre-release `qa-run` records (#21720, #21721, #21782, #21784) parked 24 partial-coverage gaps on #22017. Each row now ends in exactly one disposition on its checklist item: a fixture recipe, a pin, a re-pointed clause or a recorded knownGap. The work follows `checklist-author`'s item conventions.

- 26 items across 12 area files are edited (rows 9 and 10 each cover two items). No row is dropped and no `not-run` leg is added.
- Each edited item bumps `revision` by exactly one. Its new `history` entry cites its record and #22017 (`ref: "#22017"`).
- Docs only: `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json`. There is no product code, no new test and no `coverage.json` change.
- Every `automated.ref` I added names a test that already exists. I read each one and checked its quoted test title verbatim, at framework `1fb274e61c`, or at objectui `0abd4f9f8769` (the `.objectui-sha` pin) for objectui pins.

Each row's reason was re-checked against `main` and the current objectui pin, not copied from its record. Five premises turned out false or stale, and the table says which (rows 1, 4, 14, 21, 22).

## The 24 rows

| # | item · leg (record) | disposition | evidence | rev |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `identity-auth.phone-signin-surfaces` A2 / A3 (#21782) | fixture recipe: boot switch | The premise "no runtime setting" holds for Settings, but the plugin has a documented boot switch, `OS_AUTH_PHONE_NUMBER_ENABLED=true`. `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` maps it to the injected AuthPlugin's `plugins.phoneNumber`, `os dev` forwards env to its serve child, and `features.phoneNumber` mirrors it (`auth-manager.ts` getPublicConfig). Run #21784 used it on `os dev`. | 2 → 3 |
| 2 | `records-forms.crud-roundtrip` A7 readonly half (#21782) | pin | `metadata-protocol/src/protocol.readonly-insert.test.ts` ("cloneData forwards the copied row AND the caller overrides whole …") pins the delegation. `objectql/src/engine-insert-static-readonly-strip.test.ts` pins the real-engine strip and the defaultValue fallback. | 8 → 9 |
| 3 | `records-forms.import-wizard-encoding-and-hints` A3 (#21782) | pin (pin-only by design) | The objectui `importLegacyReferenceGuard.test.tsx` is present at `0abd4f9f8769`. No live server reaches the legacy path: the console's ObjectStackAdapter always has `importRecords`. | 4 → 5 |
| 4 | `records-forms.gantt-interactions` A2 / A3 (#21782) | pin | Premise false: `lockField`, `dependenciesField` and `parentField` are all `GanttConfigSchema` keys (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`, also at the run's subject `316be321`), so no clause needed a re-point. The objectui pins are named per clause: `GanttView.autoscheduledlg`, `countinterp.i18n`, `scheduling.selfextent` and `GanttView.dnd`. One residual sub-leg, a direct drag on a locked leaf, is recorded blocked(fixture). | 2 → 3 |
| 5 | `search.command-palette-navigation` A5 (#21782) | fixture recipe | The smallest fixture is a scratch-copy showcase nav with two leaves, `visible: 'false'` and `visible: 'true'`. It is authored from source and not yet run-proven. The clause named `visibleOn`, which a nav item refuses as a near-miss (`app.zod.ts` NAV_ITEM_ALIASES), so it now names `visible` only. | 1 → 2 |
| 6 | `records-forms.grid-personalization` A1 reorder / pin (#21782) | re-pointed clause | `reorderableColumns` is an `ObjectGridPropsSchema` prop (`component.zod.ts`) that ObjectGrid defaults false, never a ListView key. Pin is the author-declared `ListColumnSchema.pinned`. The persisted columnState holds widths and order only. | 2 → 3 |
| 7 | `records-forms.action-location-matrix` A3 url / api (#21782) | recorded knownGap + card owed | Revision 7 (#21797) already scores the legs blocked(fixture) with record_more. The fix is an `examples/app-showcase` change that no card carries (#21797 breach B-1, unfiled). It is reported below for the seat to file. | 7 → 8 |
| 8 | `i18n.surface-matrix` A6 confirm half (#21782) | pin | No showcase action declares a `confirmText` at all. The objectui pins `page-header-action-i18n.test.tsx` and `record-quick-actions.actionText-i18n.test.tsx` resolve the confirm body from `_actions` zh-CN through the real ActionRunner. | 5 → 6 |
| 9a | `platform-core.keyboard-shortcut-surface` A5 (#21782) | recorded knownGap (environment) | ⌘⇧O / ⌘⇧S live on the AI chat page, which exists only where an agent catalog serves an agent (Cloud/Enterprise `service-ai`). CI has no such deployment. The verdict is reclassified blocked(environment). | 1 → 2 |
| 9b | `ai.console-ai-surface-gating` A2 entitled side (#21782) | recorded knownGap (environment) | Same environment, and CI lacks it. The objectui hook pins are named as mechanism-only. | 2 → 3 |
| 10a | `platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render` catalog (#21782) | recorded knownGap (environment) | The leg needs a boot that reaches `DEFAULT_CLOUD_URL` (`packages/cloud-connection/src/cloud-url.ts`) or a reachable `OS_CLOUD_URL`. No CI job drives it. | 4 → 5 |
| 10b | `platform-core.marketplace-console-honesty` boot A catalog (#21782) | recorded knownGap (environment) | Same environment as 10a. | 2 → 3 |
| 11 | `access-security.rls-both-sides` A6 (#21720) | recorded knownGap | The D11 spot-check needs the maintainer's private write-up and its private remediation card (#7463 ruling), which no public record or CI carries. The skipped-object half stays scoreable. The text is non-disclosing. | 5 → 6 |
| 12 | `access-security.write-path-guards` N2 (#21720) | pin | `objectql/src/engine-insert-static-readonly-strip.test.ts` ("isSystem seeds the readonly column …") covers INSERT, and `engine-readonly-strip-caller-values.test.ts` ("an isSystem caller is untouched by any of this") covers UPDATE. Both use a real engine. | 3 → 4 |
| 13 | `api-backend.declarative-endpoint-execution` A3 (#21720) | re-pointed clause | No public door serves a script / proxy endpoint. `api` is code-only (#5488, `allowRuntimeCreate` false), and the stack schema refuses both types (`endpoint-publish-gate.ts` validateApiEndpointDeclarations). A3 now asserts the authoring refusal (oracle build). The runtime 501 is pinned by `endpoint-executor.test.ts` and `apis-publish-gates.test.ts` gate (a). | 1 → 2 |
| 14 | `records-forms.predicate-relationship-traversal` A4 (#21720) | re-pointed clause | The knownGap was false: `showcase_member_default` grants `showcase_account` read to every member (`examples/app-showcase/src/security/permission-sets.ts`), and grants are additive, so the persona cannot exist on stock. A4 is scored from `objectql/src/engine-predicate-relationship.test.ts` (related read under SYSTEM authority; accept / refuse on the real write path), or live on the scratch-object substitute #21720 measured. | 1 → 2 |
| 15 | `identity-auth.admin-lifecycle-operations` A4–A6 (#21784) | re-pointed clause | set-role is ruled (#9968, ruled B); revoke-user-sessions and remove-user are ruled (#9969, not_planned). A4–A6 now assert the ruled 403s with their vendor codes and a no-effect read, pinned by `admin-platform-admin-standing.dogfood.test.ts`. The cascade exemption is scored from plugin-security's "[#3023]" test. Step 2 (list-users) follows the same ruling. | 6 → 7 |
| 16 | `studio-authoring.expression-editors` A8 (#21784) | pin (environment named) | The objectui `celAuthoring.test.ts` "graceful degradation" is present at `0abd4f9f8769`. The leg is pin-only by clause design. The knownGap names the environment, an objectui checkout at the pin. | 2 → 3 |
| 17 | `studio-authoring.metadata-diagnostics-sweep` A7 (#21784) | recorded knownGap (environment) | The leg needs a store already holding a stale row. A stock environment never holds one, by design, and no CI job builds one. The producer pin (`metadata-diagnostics.union-issues.test.ts`) is named as mechanism-only. | 1 → 2 |
| 18 | `integration-system.datasource-credential-refusal-matrix` A2 / A7 (#21784) | recorded knownGap (already, #21932 rev 3) | This was already parked today by #21932. This PR adds whether CI has the database: postgres and mysql exist only in the Temporal Conformance job, which runs no checklist item, and there is no mongo. It also adds the record citation. | 3 → 4 |
| 19 | `approvals.decision-action-matrix` A10 (#21784) | pin | `plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.test.ts` describe "org-filtered read-back refuses loudly (#12769)". The api-trigger candidate is refuted, since the run found it org-stamped. The wire-envelope half stays unobserved on stock. | 3 → 4 |
| 20 | `identity-auth.auth-method-matrix` A1 SSO / device + N3 (#21784) | recorded knownGap | `serve.ts` injects AuthPlugin with four env-mapped plugins and no `deviceAuthorization` or `oidcProviders`. SSO has the `OS_SSO_ENABLED` switch but needs a registered provider behind a reachable IdP. N3's dependency, objectui#4179, closed not_planned on 2026-09-24. | 5 → 6 |
| 21 | `integration-system.external-schema-browser-ui` A7 (#21784) | re-pointed clause | Stale expected-fail. At objectui `0abd4f9f8769`, objectui#11628 (PR #11640) maps the server's `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` 503 envelope to `ExternalServiceUnavailableError`, pinned by `api.test.ts`. The run's console `2e818d0b51ec` predates the fix. A7 is now a positive assertion scored from the pin; the live render still needs an unwired boot. | 1 → 2 |
| 22 | `records-forms.encrypted-field-behavior` A4 (#21784) | pin (pin-only of necessity) | `objectql/src/secret-fields.test.ts` ("fail-closed: writing a secret field with no CryptoProvider throws"). The knownGap's "production boot without OS_SECRET_KEY" path was wrong: that boot refuses to start (`serve.ts` rethrows). | 1 → 2 |
| 23 | `cli.flag-command-error-ux` A4 (#21721) | re-pointed clause | 33 variants: 20 command files and 12 topic directories in `packages/cli/src/commands`, plus generate's `static aliases = ['g']`. `secret`, `storage` and `g` are added, and A4's count is now derived per run. | 2 → 3 |
| 24 | `cli.datasource-introspect-codegen` A1 narrowing half (#21721) | pin | `rest/src/remote-tables-twin.equivalence.test.ts` covers `?schema=` narrowing and the empty set on the federation route the CLI calls. `external-datasource-service.test.ts` adds "filters by requested schema", and `envelope-unwrap.test.ts` adds the "no remote tables" print. SQLite tables carry no schema, so `listRemoteTables` never filters them. | 3 → 4 |

Tally: 2 fixture recipes · 9 pins · 6 re-pointed clauses · 7 recorded knownGaps (counted by row; rows 9 and 10 cover two items each).

## For the seat (not filed here)

- **Card owed (row 7):** "showcase: host record_header / record_more / record_related surfaces for showcase_task". It needs a showcase_task page that composes a record header, and a parent record page that renders the synthesized Tasks related list. Evidence: `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/task-detail.page.ts` is `kind: 'full'` with no record header node, and `project-detail.page.ts` replaces the related strip with `record:line_items`. #21797 named it breach B-1 and left it unfiled. `records-forms.action-location-matrix` A1's three variants and A3's url / api legs park on it.

## Acceptance notes

- **Two recipes are not run-proven.** Row 1's boot switch was booted by run #21784 for another item. Row 5's scratch-copy nav is authored from source only. Both items say so, and neither claims coverage.
- **Residuals named inside a disposition:**
  - row 4: a direct drag on a locked leaf;
  - row 19: the wire envelope;
  - row 21: the live render on an unwired boot;
  - row 24: the CLI's `--schema` to `?schema=` forwarding.

  Each is written into its item as blocked or unpinned, never as a pass.
- **Not fixed here (same items, outside the 24 rows):**
  - `external-schema-browser-ui` requires text still says "5 columns each"; the runs measured `columnCount` 7. #21797 listed it as unparked.
  - RUNNER.md's standing fact counts "23 items" whose `automated.ref` is objectui-only; the ledger has 28 at base, and this PR adds two more (rows 8 and 21), for 30.

  Carrier for both: none.
- **Framework pins were read, not run locally.** They live in packages this PR does not touch and run in CI's required suites on `main`. objectui pins were checked at the pinned revision by `git show`.

## Verification

Gate list derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths, merge-base) at head `25b451177`: 13 commands, all `exit 0`, and `--ran` reconciled "13 derived, 13 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)".

- `check:platform-checklist`: OK — 276 items. Symbol anchors are 709/719 resolved (base 697/707, +12, all resolving), and 0 line citations survive.
- `check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3 (prerequisite not met: lint/formula not built). That run was NOT MEASURED. After `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint`, it exited 0.
- The other 11: `check-ci-filter-parity`, `check-closing-keyword-parity` (and `--self-test`), `check-comment-mask-corpus`, `cross-package-test-inputs`, `doc-authoring`, `driver-memory-census`, `gitlink-declared`, `nul-bytes`, `refd-timer-probe` and `watch-hint-literal` all exited 0.
- A semantic diff against base: exactly the 26 intended items changed, each by revision +1 with one appended history entry citing its record. No other item and no top-level key moved.

Changeset: none. `docs/qa/**` ships in no package's `files[]`, so this is `skip-changeset`.
